summary: Build practical behavioural insights skills for public policy design. Learn EAST, MINDSPACE, nudges, and evaluation methods. Enrol now.
lede: Behavioural insights help policy and programme teams identify why people may not take up or complete public services. This course is for professionals in policy, programme delivery, and evaluation who need to turn policy goals into workable interventions. You will practise diagnosing behavioural barriers, designing nudges and clearer communications, and planning evaluations using measures such as baseline comparisons, randomised controlled trials, and A/B testing.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work inside policy, programme, delivery, or evaluation environments and need a stronger behavioural toolkit. It suits you if you are responsible for improving public service outcomes, advising leadership, or turning policy intent into workable programme design. Policy Analysts shaping behavioural options in draft policy notes. Programme Managers improving uptake and completion in public services. Monitoring and Evaluation Specialists defining outcome measures for interventions. Public Service Delivery Leads reducing friction in citizen-facing journeys. Behavioural Insights Officers testing nudges and communication changes. Public Sector Planners aligning interventions with policy objectives. Regulatory Compliance Officers reviewing behavioural proposals for fit and risk. Service Design Specialists simplifying forms, reminders, and digital journeys. Strategy and Performance Managers tracking intervention KPIs for leadership. Social Policy Advisors translating evidence into implementable recommendations.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop and one policy, programme, or service-delivery challenge from their own work for use in exercises. A basic understanding of public policy, programme operations, or monitoring and evaluation is expected, and no specialist statistical software is required.
